d: An anthropomorphic creature featuring a slender build, a long pointed snout, and large cream-colored ears. The creature has a tuft of deep crimson hair styled in a sweeping, upward-curving crest and sharp, emerald green eyes with a focused expression. It wears a white headpiece, a red and white draped garment, and dark brown pleated trousers held by a gold belt with a red gem. Accessories include gold bands on the wrists and neck, and it holds a wooden staff with a stone tip. BODY COLOR: Light brown and tan LEGS: Digitigrade with small dark hooves
